messages:
Rina: hi team, Rina here 34 starting on infra today. quick: who do i ping to get deploy rights, who owns the service mappings, and what's the immediate pager escalation path?

DevPlatform Bot: Welcome Rina! For deploys: Eng Platform reviews perms. Please open an access request (People Ops) and include repo list + justification.

Rina: thanks. where is the authoritative service-owner list? the repo OWNERS or some central registry?

Omar: both exist. Each service repo has OWNERS at the root. We also maintain a central registry at https://infra.redwood/owners (read-only until you have view perms). For oncall contact info use the OWNERS email field.

Tess: ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of OWNERS format. Also, for deploy permission requests include the names of a peer approver from the OWNERS file to speed approval.

Rina: got it. what if i get paged at 2am and can't reach the owner?

Omar: escalation: try owner -> team fallback in OWNERS -> Eng Platform oncall -> SRE primary -> SRE manager. If it's an infra-wide SEV, call the SEV pager and follow the SEV runbook.

People Ops Bot: To request deploy + k8s access start a ticket: https://people-ops.redwood/tickets new hire template. Include GH handle and desired envs.

Rina: i'm missing Vault MFA setup. anyone shipped YubiKeys to remote folks recently?

Tess: yes, security ships YubiKeys. Open a security support request with your address and they'll overnight. Temporary Okta OTP can be issued if needed for a day.

Rina: sweet. one last thing 34 who owns runbook maintenance? i want to know who to tag when something is outdated.

Omar: runbooks live in each service repo under /runbooks. The runbook owner is listed at the top; if missing, tag the service owner. We also have a triage rotation for stale runbooks (email: runbook-maintenance@redwood).

Rina: awesome, thanks everyone. happy to be here! :party_popper:

Tess: welcome! if you want, drop your calendar and i9ll add a 15m walkthrough later today.

Rina: 4pm works.

DevPlatform Bot: Note: onboarding checklist for Rina updated: deploy-request created, vault-mfa pending.
